decisions.reason: As a compliance-adjacent software line with some early agency validation and low carrying cost, it still has option value while demand uncertainty resolves and fits the firm's stated push into compliance capabilities.

Because it is a flagship platform built directly on the core hosting business and highlighted on the home page, management would strongly prefer to preserve this strategic option rather than exit it after only an initial market period.

A configurable managed hosting plan is very close to the established offer, likely inexpensive to continue on existing infrastructure, and shows no clear negative signal that would justify abandoning the option yet.
